title: Interfacial adsorption and dynamics of fluorotelomers with soil minerals – mechanistic insights
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2024, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4EN00465E, Paper
Open Access

Narasimhan Loganathan, Libby Ashby, Christina E. Schumm, Angela K. Wilson
This study determines the critical interactions that dictate the adsorption characteristics of fluorotelomers in the confined pores of neutral, low and high charged clay minerals in soil.
